title: Bind Simple Create voice selection and runtime smoke
description: Make the simplified Create voice picker use the currently configured existing TTS path and update the Electron smoke to exercise the current Create flow.
businessContext: V1 requires users to choose an available existing voice without silently switching providers, and the runtime smoke must verify the simplified shell rather than the removed New Project wizard.
acceptanceCriteria: Simple Create only offers enabled, non-experimental voices from the currently configured TTS path and stores the provider voice identifier consumed by that path.
Voice Generation prefers the project-selected existing voice and does not silently replace it with another provider or voice.
The Electron UI smoke creates the documented VOX topic project through Create Video Project and verifies the simplified workspace navigation without using New Project.
Focused verification, typecheck, and diff checks pass.
humanEscalationConditions: The configured TTS path cannot expose a trusted available voice catalog.
